contrasts.line: Shiny is smooth and mirror-like; sparkly has many tiny glitter bits.
Dazzling hurts your eyes. Shiny just reflects, like a polished spoon.
Shiny bounces back a clear image; radiant seems to glow from inside.
Shiny is smooth and mirror-like; twinkling blinks on and off.
Sparkly has many tiny glitter bits; shiny is smooth and mirror-like.
Dazzling is one overwhelming glare. Sparkly is little dots of light.
Sparkly has tiny glints on a surface; radiant seems to glow from within.
Sparkly shows many glitter bits; twinkling goes on and off.
Shiny shows your face like a mirror. Dazzling is so bright it hurts to look.
Sparkly is lots of tiny flashes. Dazzling is one huge blast of light.
Radiant glows out gently. Dazzling makes you squint.
Twinkling blinks on and off softly. Dazzling blazes all at once.
Radiant seems to glow from inside; shiny is smooth and mirror-like.
Radiant gives a warm inner glow; sparkly has tiny glitter bits.
Dazzling is harsh and blinding. Radiant is a soft steady glow.
Radiant glows strongly from within; twinkling blinks on and off.
Twinkling blinks on and off; shiny is smooth and mirror-like.
Twinkling goes on and off; sparkly has many tiny glitter bits.
Dazzling blasts out all at once. Twinkling comes and goes in little winks.
Twinkling blinks on and off; radiant glows strongly from within.

meta.scrub_note: glossy swapped for radiant: G3 found glossy is a lemma of shiny's pinned synset. gleaming swapped for dazzling: shiny/gleaming proved judge-inseparable on polished-surface frames.
